analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 강도는 약함. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 회복 신호는 있으나, SMA5($0.95)가 현재가($0.89)보다 높아 단기 저항 구간. 거래량은 증가했으나 추세 전환 확신 부족.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has entered oversold territory, and while MACD histogram shows improvement, trend strength remains weak. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, indicating a recovery signal, but the SMA5 ($0.95) is above the current price ($0.89), forming a short-term resistance zone. Volume has increased, but conviction for a trend reversal is lacking.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 33.5로 과매도 구간 진입, 주봉 ADX 21.3으로 추세 형성 초기 단계. 일봉과 주봉 모두 약세 신호이나, 4시간봉 RSI 30.9로 과매도 구간 진입하여 일봉과 정렬.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 33.5 in oversold territory, weekly ADX at 21.3 in early trend formation. Both daily and weekly show weak signals, but 4H RSI at 30.9 also in oversold, aligning with daily.

· Position vs SMA100 ($1.31)/SMA200 ($1.24): below long-term trends, bearish.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0207→-0.0086): improving, weak signal for bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $0.83): approaching lower band, band width wide at 46.35%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($1.13): potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): requires observation and further indicator confirmation.
